_note: The focus graph's vectors (lvgl-switch.md §2.6.1): each case is a graph, the targets in the order the view lists them, the view's answers to the selectors, an optional roomAt rectangle, the target the ring is on, a key and the id it must land on. prototypes/ui/focus.mjs (focus.test.mjs) and the face's C port (face_test) both run every case. `refusals` are graphs the loader must refuse; `sound` are graphs it must accept.
